title: Schedule the delivery sweeper (EventBridge Scheduler) so retryable deliveries recover
description: sweepStaleDeliveries exists but nothing invokes it. A reply whose three asynchronous delivery attempts all fail stays retryable forever. Add a scheduled invocation per environment (EventBridge Scheduler or a rule) of a sweeper function with least-privilege access, and an alarm on gave-up deliveries. Found in the PR 648 review.
